versions.name: R-C Scout Ranch

features.note: Bunk cabins among nineteen lodging and activity buildings.
The Anne N. Forsman Dining Hall.

versions.summary: Grand Canyon Council's R-C Scout Ranch, a former cattle ranch of about eighty acres at the base of Christopher Mountain east of Payson, Arizona. Named for the council's original Roosevelt Council, it hosts a Cub Scout family resident camp and year-round unit camping among historic stone-and-log lodges.

sources.citation: Camp identity split via Camp Finder Suggest-a-Correction form; submitted by camp staff 2026-08-31 (submission DqaG0Nl), kept anonymous at submitter request. Grand Canyon Council runs R-C Scout Ranch (this record; Payson) and Camp Raymond (Parks) as two distinct properties; a prior camp-finder import had folded R-C's identity onto the Parks property. This R-C (Payson) record was authored from the camp's own site and reservation portal.

provenance.notes: Authored 2026-09-10 to correct a camp-finder import that mislabeled Grand Canyon Council's Camp Raymond (Parks, near Flagstaff) as 'R-C Scout Ranch'. This record is the real R-C Scout Ranch near Payson (19887 E AZ Hwy 260), a separate property roughly seventy-five miles southeast of Camp Raymond; the mislabeled Parks content now lives in az-camp-raymond. The camp-staff submission (high trust, DqaG0Nl) is corroborated by area4history, which lists R-C Scout Ranch (Payson) and Camp Raymond as separate camps, and by the property's own site. Coordinate is the property pin published on the camp's Black Pug reservation page (geo_precision exact); elevation from open-meteo Copernicus DEM (1720 m rounds to 5640 ft); july_high_f/july_low_f sampled from the WorldClim v2.1 30s normals at the point (tools/july_temp.py). Features are a thin camp_page/portal survey (dining hall, cabins, ramadas, archery and BB ranges, climbing tower) and belong in the standing survey queue. The submitter's aside that R-C 'was sold this year' is NOT corroborated - the property shows active 2026 registrations and reservations - so operating_status stays active.
